R424.note: Extension allowlist, size limit, UUID filename and normalize()/startsWith() containment fully close CWE-434; the type restriction is the core remediation for this CWE, not a bystander restriction.

R425.note: Appends File.separator to BASE_DIR before startsWith(), correctly closing the sibling-directory bypass without narrowing legitimate access.

R426.note: UUID filename plus private directory and a controlled /avatars/:filename route satisfy the stated contract (JSON url still fetchable, 400 shape unchanged).

R427.note: Verified against ASP.NET Core source: AntiforgeryOptions.HeaderName defaults to "RequestVerificationToken" and DefaultAntiforgeryTokenStore checks the header before any form parsing, so the JSON-bound handler's ValidateRequestAsync(context) call genuinely validates a header-supplied token, matching the stated contract.

R428.note: Adds .RequireAuthorization() (DefaultPolicy: authenticated) to the previously-open MapDelete, closing the missing-authorization gap consistently with the sibling controller's baseline.

R429.note: Verified fast-xml-parser rejects DOCTYPE external entities outright, closing XXE regardless of the processEntities flag; but verified numeric auto-parsing means the response's orderId silently changes from string "123" (libxmljs) to number 123, an undisclosed output-type change.

R430.note: snprintf with truncation checks at both the intermediate and output copy closes the overflow while preserving the function's 0/-1 return contract.

R431.note: Rejects ':' '/' '\\' to force a plain filename, then canonicalizes with realpath() and a separator-terminated containment check, directly closing the reported stream-wrapper evasion of the '..'-only denylist.

R432.note: GetFullPath()+GetRelativePath() containment check correctly rejects both absolute-path override and '..' traversal while leaving legitimate relative filenames unaffected.

R433.note: Wraps the export handler with the same requireAdmin middleware already applied to the sibling ban/unban routes, directly closing the missing-authorization gap.

R434.note: Verified against Commons Net 3.11.1 source: FTP.buildMessage() concatenates the RETR argument into the control-channel line with no CRLF filtering, so an embedded CRLF in requestedFileName still injects additional FTP commands - the library swap is a no-op for the reported vector, though it introduces no new issue.

R435.note: Unsigned bounds check (playerIndex >= MAX_PLAYERS) correctly rejects any out-of-range index before the write.

R436.note: Drops the cmd.exe /c shell string for a direct ping.exe argv array, closing the reported shell-metacharacter injection; a host value starting with '-' could still be read as a ping.exe flag (option injection), a distinct and lesser gap outside the reported finding.

R437.note: Allowlist mapping tool name to a fixed set of trusted executables is the correct fix for a tainted-executable-name finding, not an artificial restriction on a legitimate value.
